Plushie Tower🧸 [UPDATE🐬]

👋Welcome to Plushie Tower! This is a Tower Obby game featuring multiple unique towers with a variety of plushie themes and a wide range of colors. Enjoy the game and collect all the badges.

🛠️Update Log :
    - Added a new tower : [Dolphin Tower 🐬💜]
    - Fixed some stages and bugs

🔒Mobile Shiftlock Supported
📝Commands : /korblox & /headless
